review_evidence: README describes playing Sudoku by proving cell values in Lean and explicitly notes formalized Sudoku theory in Basic.lean.
Basic.lean proves row/column/box membership, conflict and pencil-mark/deduction lemmas; STactic.lean implements proof automation over that formal model.
Three of five Lean files contain proposition declarations, so the source is not merely a game/UI implementation.
summary: Reviewed LeanSudoku; retain its formal Sudoku model, deduction lemmas and proof tactics.
